title: Brain criticality predicts individual levels of inter-areal synchronization (Fusca, Siebenhuehner, Wang et al., 2023): SEEG/MEG PLV and DFA (derivative)
description: This derivative dataset provides processed results of phase synchronization (phase-locking value) and detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA) computed from resting-state stereo-EEG of 68 drug-resistant focal epilepsy patients and MEG of 52 healthy participants. It also includes simulated hierarchical Kuramoto model data. The data support the finding that brain criticality predicts individual levels of inter-areal synchronization. Raw recordings are not included; the files repackage the authors' public Dryad release into per-patient files and tables.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded for 10 minutes of eyes-closed rest in 68 patients. Epileptic-artifact windows were rejected, and contacts were referenced to the closest white-matter contact. Data were filtered and decomposed with 24 Morlet wavelets (2-225 Hz) to compute PLV between contact pairs and DFA exponents per contact. MEG covered 192 eyes-open resting-state sessions from 52 healthy subjects, source-reconstructed to the 400-parcel Schaefer atlas, with wPLI and DFA computed. Simulations used hierarchical Kuramoto models.
